results.content: Roman Reigns officially has his next challenger—and WWE wasted no time putting them nose-to-nose inside the ring. During the episode of WWE RAW taped for August 31, Penta defeated his brother Rey Fenix in the main event to earn a match against Reigns. That showdown is scheduled for the September 14 episode of RAW in Mexico City, Mexico. The champion walked to the ring, stepped directly in front of his new challenger and raised the title over his head. He stood his ground and answered with his signature pose as the two stared each other down, giving fans their first look at the match WWE is bringing to Mexico City.
